HediffDef.label: lightning disciple
HediffDef.description: Learned lightning techniques: 40% ability damage and 50% longer base cooldowns. No ascension stat boosts, recovery, mood bonus or teaching power. Call a bound elemental sword. Unlock the Ascend button after 50 credited kills and five in-game days as a disciple. Press it to perform a 3.5-second ascension ceremony; NPC disciples begin automatically when eligible; serum remains an alternative. One saved 5% chance to awaken into a normal Ascendant when critically hurt in hostile combat, bypassing the kill/day milestones. Awakening repairs ordinary injuries and blood loss, manifests Ascendant gear and releases an elemental shockwave. NPC disciples automatically call their swords.
